FIBC BULK BAGS

Heavy-duty big bags,
engineered to your spec.

FIBC (Flexible Intermediate Bulk Containers) for cement, chemicals, minerals, agriculture and construction — from 500 kg to 2000 kg safe working load, in any loop configuration, fully customisable.

WHAT IS FIBC?

FIBC bags are heavy-duty bulk packaging solutions designed for the safe handling, storage, and transportation of industrial materials.

Engineered for strength, durability, and high load-bearing capacity, our FIBC bags are widely used in industries such as cement, chemicals, minerals, agriculture, and construction. We offer fully customizable FIBC bags tailored to customer-specific requirements, ensuring performance, safety, and compliance with global quality standards.

Production capacity: 200,000+ FIBC bags per month from our integrated facility in Rewa, MP.

WHY OSRM FIBC

Built for performance,

FEATURE 01

100% recyclable mono-material

Constructed from woven polypropylene fabric — fully recyclable through our in-house Polystar Repro line, supporting your EPR compliance.

FEATURE 02

UV-stabilised & weather-resistant

Engineered for outdoor storage and long-distance transport. Resistant to UV degradation, moisture and abrasion.

FEATURE 03

Food-grade & industrial-grade options

Available in food-grade variants for agricultural and edible product packaging, and industrial-grade for chemicals, minerals, and aggregates.

FEATURE 04

Custom GSM & printing

Fabric GSM and print configurations are tailored to product weight, transport conditions, and brand requirements — including up to 8-colour flexographic printing.
